title_sq: Shesim Apartament 2+1+2 Te Fillimi Kodres Diellit
description_sq:
Ne fillim te Kodres te Diellit rreshti pare i pallateve shesim apartament 2+1+2
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje pallat te ri te administruar dhe me ashensor, ndodhet ne katin e 5 me orjentim veri.
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe 117 m2 bruto dhe 107 neto nje organizim shume te mire dhe shitet sic eshte ne foto i mobiluar.
Organizohet ne korridor qe ben shperndarjen ne sallon dhe ne dhoma.
Organizohet ne 1 sallon ndenje me kuzhine dhe dalje ne ballkon
2 dhoma gjumi njera me tualet
2 tualete dhe nje depo.
Zona ne te cilen ndodhet eshte e aksesueshme dhe te ofron te gjitha facilitet e nevojshme
Disponon certifikate pronesi
title_en: Apartment for sale 2+1+2 at the beginning of the Hill of the Sun
description_en: At the beginning of Kodre te Diellit, the first row of buildings, we sell an apartment 2+1+2. The apartment is located in a new, managed building with an elevator, it is located on the 5th floor, facing north. The apartment has an area of ​​117 m2 gross and 107 m2 net, a very good organization and is sold as it is in the photo, furnished. It is organized in a corridor that distributes it in the living room and in the rooms. It is organized in 1 living room with kitchen and exit to the balcony, 2 bedrooms, one with a toilet, 2 toilets and a storage room. The area in which it is located is accessible and offers all the necessary facilities. It has ownership certificates
